initialization: Every trading day in the previous calendar OOF year; start with equal cash, carry actual account and ages across model-year switch. 2011 is initialization only because no earlier OOF exists. No synthetic account reset at scoring boundary.
scoring_calendar: Returns whose next-open valuation date falls in evaluation year; identical masks for every candidate/start. No post-2021 outcome in search.
starts: Deterministic evenly spaced nested subsets chosen without returns; all candidates at a stage use identical starts.

selection.typical: equal-fold mean of within-fold median Calmar
selection.tail: equal-fold mean of within-fold linear-quantile 0.20 Calmar

holdout.access: only after winner locked; never used for selection

additional_diagnostics: equal-length fresh-account launches within available OOF
limitations: same-open signal/execution retains existing idealized timing
corporate action settlement retains existing economic approximation
overlapping starts are not independent markets
final model differs from rolling fold models
existing features and outer history are not newly blind
